comparison.objective: Close a quarter-turn gas valve and secure it with a pin through aligned handle and tab holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Turn a stopped handle, align two holes, and insert a pin until its head seats.
comparison.success_condition: Valve fully shut and pin passed through both holes with its head resting on the handle.
comparison.reason: It shares precision alignment and insertion, but tests lockout-pin seating after valve actuation rather than bimanual hammer impact, controlled fracture, and recovery of four released tangs.
